title: Language Techniques — With Examples
skills: identify common language techniques in texts
analyze how language choices shape meaning and effect
distinguish among different literary and rhetorical techniques
support analysis of language techniques with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces a range of language techniques through examples and explains how writers use them to shape meaning, tone, emphasis, imagery, and reader response. Supports close reading, literary analysis, author's craft, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
